versions.subject: split global win_software_discovery.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\reg.exe'    # Example: reg query "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Microsoft\Internet Explorer" /v svcVersion
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'query'
        - '\software\'
        - '/v'
        - 'svcversion'
condition: selection
